 }

  save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = tsin_contract_id value = this }
  scope:tsin_contract_coordinator = {
   tsin_contract_bind_effect = yes
   if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(tsin_fc_kind|scope:tsin_contract_id)" = 1 }

   }
   if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(tsin_fc_kind|scope:tsin_contract_id)" = 2 }
    scope:tsin_fc_borrower ?= {
     change_variable = { name = tsin_firm_debt add = tsin_contract_reference_principal }
     set_variable = { name = tsin_arrears value = { value = var:tsin_arrears min = "global_variable_map(tsin_fc_missed|scope:tsin_contract_id)" } }
    }
   }

add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_fc_fx key = scope:tsin_contract_id value = 1 }
add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_fc_principal key = scope:tsin_contract_id value = tsin_ledger_lot }
add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_fc_rate key = scope:tsin_contract_id value = 4 }
add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_fc_maturity key = scope:tsin_contract_id value = { value = tsin_contract_calendar_month add = 36 } }
add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_fc_next_coupon key = scope:tsin_contract_id value = { value = tsin_contract_calendar_month add = 1 } }
add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_fc_period key = scope:tsin_contract_id value = 1 }
add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_fc_missed key = scope:tsin_contract_id value = 0 }
add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_fc_kind key = scope:tsin_contract_id value = 3 }
add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_fc_maturity_mode key = scope:tsin_contract_id value = 0 }
add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_fc_timer_origin key = scope:tsin_contract_id value = scope:tsin_fc_borrower }

 add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = { value = tsin_ledger_lot multiply = -1 } }
 change_variable = { name = tsin_firm_cash add = tsin_ledger_lot }
 set_variable = { name = tsin_bond_issue_cooldown years = 4 }
 }
 tsin_contract_refresh_effect = yes
}

tsin_contract_adjust_private_effect = {
 save_scope_as = tsin_fc_repay_actor save_scope_as = tsin_contract_coordinator
 save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = tsin_fc_adjust_left value = $AMOUNT$ }
 every_in_global_list = { variable = tsin_active_contracts add_to_list = tsin_fc_adjust_ids }
 every_in_list = { list = tsin_fc_adjust_ids
 save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = tsin_contract_id value = this }
 scope:tsin_contract_coordinator = {
 if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(tsin_fc_kind|scope:tsin_contract_id)" = $KIND$ "global_variable_map(tsin_fc_borrower|scope:tsin_contract_id)" ?= scope:tsin_fc_repay_actor scope:tsin_fc_adjust_left > 0 }
 tsin_contract_bind_effect = yes
 save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = tsin_fc_adjust_amount value = { value = scope:tsin_fc_adjust_left max = tsin_contract_reference_principal min = 0 } }
 if = { limit = { NOT = { always = $LOSS$ } }
  scope:tsin_fc_borrower = { change_variable = { name = tsin_firm_cash subtract = scope:tsin_fc_adjust_amount } }
  if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(tsin_fc_kind|scope:tsin_contract_id)" = 3 } scope:tsin_fc_lender = { add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:tsin_fc_adjust_amount } } }
  else = { scope:tsin_fc_lender = { change_variable = { name = tsin_bank_cash add = scope:tsin_fc_adjust_amount } } }
 }
 else = {
  if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(tsin_fc_kind|scope:tsin_contract_id)" = 3 } scope:tsin_fc_borrower = { change_variable = { name = tsin_bond_losses add = scope:tsin_fc_adjust_amount } } }
  else = { scope:tsin_fc_lender = { change_variable = { name = tsin_bank_losses add = scope:tsin_fc_adjust_amount } } }
 }
 add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_fc_principal key = scope:tsin_contract_id value = { value = "global_variable_map(tsin_fc_principal|scope:tsin_contract_id)" subtract = { value = scope:tsin_fc_adjust_amount multiply = "global_variable_map(tsin_fc_fx|scope:tsin_contract_id)" } min = 0 } }
 save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = tsin_fc_adjust_left value = { value = scope:tsin_fc_adjust_left subtract = scope:tsin_fc_adjust_amount min = 0 } }
 if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(tsin_fc_principal|scope:tsin_contract_id)" <= 0 } tsin_contract_forget_effect = yes }
 }
 }
 }
 tsin_contract_refresh_effect = yes
}
tsin_contract_repay_facility_effect = {
 tsin_contract_adjust_private_effect = { KIND = 2 LOSS = no AMOUNT = tsin_ledger_repayment }
}

# Explicit repair only: caller must supply a verified original date.
tsin_contract_restore_legacy_maturity_effect = {
 save_scope_as = tsin_fc_restore_actor
 save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = tsin_contract_id value = $ID$ }
 save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = tsin_fc_restore_year value = $YEAR$ }
 save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = tsin_fc_restore_month value = $MONTH$ }
 if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(tsin_fc_kind|scope:tsin_contract_id)" = 3 "global_variable_map(tsin_fc_maturity_mode|scope:tsin_contract_id)" = 2
 "global_variable_map(tsin_fc_borrower|scope:tsin_contract_id)" ?= scope:tsin_fc_restore_actor
 scope:tsin_fc_restore_year >= 1337 scope:tsin_fc_restore_year <= 2337
 scope:tsin_fc_restore_month >= 1 scope:tsin_fc_restore_month <= 12 }
 add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_fc_maturity key = scope:tsin_contract_id value = { value = scope:tsin_fc_restore_year multiply = 12 add = scope:tsin_fc_restore_month } }
 add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_fc_maturity_mode key = scope:tsin_contract_id value = 0 }
 tsin_contract_refresh_effect = yes
 }
}
